### bubbleChannel2d

This example shows an advecting bubble of air in a channel of water.
The bubble has a size of 40 micrometers and has the exact surface tension of an air-water mixture.
This high surface tension creates the necessity for a trick at the outlet, using a fringe zone.
This setup achieves a nice shape of the bubble at the artificial outlet, which is roughly five bubble diameters before the actual domain outlet.
